card.headline: Another word for "amazing"
card.sub: 10 better words with pictures and examples

beats.speech: Looking for another word for amazing? Here are ten better words: five for everyday conversation, and five stronger words for writing and for work. Each one comes with a picture and an example. Let's start.

beats.label: everyday conversation
beats.speech: Part 1. Five words for everyday conversation.

card.headline: Awesome
card.meaning: very good or impressive, in casual conversation

beats.speech: Awesome. It means very good or impressive, in casual conversation. "How was the concert?" "It was awesome."

card.headline: Incredible
card.meaning: so good that it is hard to believe
card.example: "The view from the top was incredible."

beats.speech: Incredible. It means so good that it is hard to believe. "The view from the top was incredible."

card.headline: Fantastic
card.example: "You got the job? That's fantastic news."

beats.speech: Fantastic. It means extremely good. "You got the job? That's fantastic news."

card.headline: Wonderful
card.meaning: very good, in a way that makes you happy
card.example: "We had a wonderful time at your party."

beats.speech: Wonderful. It means very good, in a way that makes you happy. "We had a wonderful time at your party."
Brilliant. It means very good, or very clever. "That's a brilliant idea."

card.headline: Which word is it?
card.question: So good that it is hard to believe: ___
card.answer: So good that it is hard to believe: incredible

beats.speech: Which word is it? So good that it is hard to believe. Incredible, or brilliant? | Incredible. The view from the top was incredible.

card.headline: Repeat after me
card.sentences:
It was awesome.
The view from the top was incredible.
That's fantastic news.
We had a wonderful time at your party.
That's a brilliant idea.

beats.speech: Now say them out loud with me. | It was awesome. | The view from the top was incredible. | That's fantastic news. | We had a wonderful time at your party. | That's a brilliant idea.

beats.label: stronger words
beats.speech: Part 2. Five stronger words. They sound good in writing and at work.
Remarkable. It means unusual and worth noticing. "She made a remarkable recovery."
Outstanding. It means much better than the rest. "The team did an outstanding job."
Extraordinary. It means far beyond what is normal. "He has an extraordinary memory."
Spectacular. It means very impressive to look at. "The fireworks were spectacular."

card.headline: Breathtaking
card.meaning: so beautiful that it surprises you
card.example: "The sunset over the sea was breathtaking."

beats.speech: Breathtaking. It means so beautiful that it surprises you. "The sunset over the sea was breathtaking."

card.headline: Which word is it?
card.question: So beautiful that it surprises you: ___
card.answer: So beautiful that it surprises you: breathtaking

beats.speech: Which word is it? So beautiful that it surprises you. Breathtaking, or outstanding? | Breathtaking. The sunset over the sea was breathtaking.

card.headline: Repeat after me
card.sentences:
She made a remarkable recovery.
The team did an outstanding job.
He has an extraordinary memory.
The fireworks were spectacular.
The sunset over the sea was breathtaking.

beats.speech: Now say them out loud with me. | She made a remarkable recovery. | The team did an outstanding job. | He has an extraordinary memory. | The fireworks were spectacular. | The sunset over the sea was breathtaking.

card.headline: Which word will you use next time?

beats.speech: That's ten words to use instead of amazing. Which one will you use next time? Write it in the comments.
